Remark
[Consistency with the scalar entropy solution of Chapter 3] ↗ def:entropy-solution-scalar-new ↗ def:integral-solution-conservation-law 1. ch11:11.4-rem-1\group Conservation Laws

Taking $\Phi (z)=\pm z$ and $\Psi (z)=\pm F(z)$ in (38) gives \[ \int _0^\infty \int _{-\infty }^\infty uv_t + F(u)v_x\, dx\, dt = 0 \] for all $v\in C_c^1(\mathbb {R}\times (0,\infty ))$. Since $u(\cdot ,t)\to g$ in $L^1$, \[ \int _0^\infty \int _{-\infty }^\infty uv_t + F(u)v_x\, dx\, dt + \int _{-\infty }^\infty gv\, dx\Big|_{t=0} = 0 \] for all $v\in C_c^1(\mathbb {R}\times [0,\infty ))$. Thus an entropy solution in this sense is an integral solution, consistently with subsection def:integral-solution-conservation-law.
